[BBC Business] Anthropic warns of 'catastrophic risk' to humankind ahead of blockbuster share listing
The company will be the first true artificial intelligence company to go public as tech firms continue to invest heavily in AI.

[BBC Business] Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know
Anthropic’s IPO prospectus is 355 pages and full of never before disclosed company information.

[BBC Business] Healey to shield low-income pensioners from income tax in the Budget
Changes are needed to prevent the full, flat-rate state pension becoming liable for income tax after it rises in April.

[BBC Business] Healey's Budget needs to sustain the stronger economy through gathering clouds
The economic is positive now but come January things could become trickier for the Labour government

[CNBC] Microsoft offers voluntary buyouts to 60,000 employees as AI leads to efficiency push
Microsoft is trying to balance a rapid AI infrastructure build-out with capital efficiency.

[CNBC] The arc of Trump: How the president lost the coalition that put him in the White House
President Trump forged an extraordinary coalition to win office in 2024. A new CNBC survey shows that coalition is now seriously weakened.

[CNBC] Investors are doing just as well this year by shunning AI. How to invest if the tech trade keeps fizzling
An S&P 500 index without AI stocks is beating the traditional index. These sectors and stocks could be winners if the AI trade keeps fraying.

[CNBC] Apple responds to user reports of broken iPhone Duo screens on new foldable phone
Apple on Monday said it was aware of the issue and that it would replace the devices under its AppleCare warranty.

[MarketWatch] Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom could buy Meta shares as part of $35 billion stock offering
Meta is looking to raise a total of $95 billion through stock-related deals that stretch into early next year.

[MarketWatch] My wife has only $80,000 saved for retirement. I have $2.2 million. Am I wrong to be shocked?
“When I brought up retiring last spring, she said she was ready whenever I was, and I took that to mean we were in good shape.”

[MarketWatch] These energy stocks are poised to profit from an imminent AI power crunch
Bloom Energy and Solaris Energy would benefit from an urgency around securing power to AI developers.

[MarketWatch] Meet the financial-literacy teacher who helps high-school students open their own Roth IRAs
Christopher Jackson got hurt before his first NFL game. He now coaches teens on building wealth.
